reconfigure_fields.title: Skill settings
reconfigure_fields.description: This skill's settingsmeta.json only uses field types we've confirmed how to map to a real form (checkboxes).

abort.no_api_url: Set the "Skills API URL" text field (under the OpenVoiceOS integration's own entities) to your ovos-skills add-on's address first, e.g. http://<hostname>:8500.
abort.catalog_unreachable: Could not reach the skill catalog via the configured Skills API URL.
abort.unknown_skill: That skill could not be found in the catalog.
abort.install_request_failed: Could not start the install — check that the ovos-skills add-on is running and the Skills API URL is correct.
abort.settings_write_failed: Could not save settings — check that the ovos-skills add-on is running and the Skills API URL is correct.
abort.no_settings_available: This skill doesn't have any settings that can be edited here — it either has no settingsmeta.json, or uses field types not yet supported by this form.

user.title: Autoconfigure TTS/STT
user.description: Picks a TTS/STT plugin for the language already set (see the Language text entity), the same way OVOS's own 'ovos-config autoconfigure' does. Writes into the shared config -- each Wyoming add-on (TTS/STT/wakeword) already prefers this over its own 'plugin' option once set, so this takes effect on their next restart. Manually editing the shared mycroft.conf, or each add-on's own 'plugin' option, both still work exactly as before -- this is just a guided shortcut to the same shared value.

abort.no_core_api_url: Set the "Core API URL" text field (under the OpenVoiceOS integration's own entities) to your ovos-core add-on's address first, e.g. http://<hostname>:8500.
abort.core_unreachable: Could not reach ovos-core at the configured Core API URL -- autoconfigure needs ovos-core installed and running (it's what actually runs OVOS's own autoconfigure logic).
abort.autoconfigure_failed: ovos-core's /autoconfigure call failed -- check that the add-on is running and the Core API URL is correct.
abort.autoconfigure_success: Done for {lang}. Changed: {changed}. TTS/STT/wakeword add-ons will pick this up on their next restart.
